objective: Propagate the proven temporal-PCA knowledge atom through orchestration, a typed thermophysical domain adapter, and the bounded QPS consumer without duplicating the mathematical implementation or inverting authority.

3PR.Refresh: pin live KEB-ITEM-0002 and current target repository heads
3PR.Probe: find the smallest genuinely distinct orchestration/domain/project propagation boundaries

3PC.Prove: validate child receipts independently from MissionControl against immutable repository revisions
3PC.Commit: merge only unchanged proven heads and bind exact merge identities

3P3.Preserve_or_Pin: pin KEB-ITEM-0002, its source digest, Cycle-2 independent receipt and the exact Cycle-3 contract merge

stop_rule: Cycle 3 reaches CONTROL only after exact immutable CoolProp and QPS child receipts are independently fetched and validated by a hosted MissionControl aggregate proof with 3/3 propagation coverage, 6/6 semantic parity at every target, 2/2 child disposition coverage, reuse_ratio=1.0, duplicate_implementation_count=0, authority_inversion_count=0 and propagation_depth>=2.
